notes.title: A new update
notes.notes:
A new update is now available. We have gathered your various suggestions in order to carry out this new update. Do not hesitate to submit new suggestions.

Changelog:
- When in the ambulance, you gain 1 life every 30 seconds
- Enemies spawn much more frequently
- Shop window moved
- Improved vehicle life

If you don't have the update right away, restart Steam.
